name: Energy and Water Data Disclosure for Local Law 84 2014 (Data for Calendar Year 2013)
description:
This dataset contains energy and water use disclosures for New York City buildings under Local Law 84, covering calendar year 2013. Each row represents a single property and includes identifying details such as property name, address, borough, building identification number, and geographic coordinates, along with building characteristics like year built, floor area, occupancy, and property type.

The core of the data is benchmarking information: site and source energy use intensity, total energy consumption, Energy Star scores and certifications, greenhouse gas emissions, and comparisons to national medians. It also breaks down fuel use by type (natural gas, fuel oils, district steam, electricity), reports water consumption from municipal and other sources, and includes energy and water costs, investments in efficiency projects, and estimated savings. A large set of columns captures property use details for specific building types—offices, hospitals, hotels, retail, multifamily housing, data centers, schools, restaurants, and many others—covering floor areas, worker and computer densities, operating
